sponsor: Brian: fund the real-process tests round
scope: Tests/evidence on frozen shipped binary and README release-number correction only. Preserve prior claims/reviews. Test scripts and full invocation/env must be committed and hash-bound, including previously private harness dependencies.

Actual separate-process yield and resume under contention: witness yielded heartbeat, lock release/reacquisition, competing writer progress, eventual pending work completion. Do not substitute unit tests or alter production to force success.

Kill a real holder mid-hold under contention, reopen with durable due markers and pending work; bind pre/post state and execution identities, prove every accepted action recovered, one settlement and no duplicate effect. Include ambiguous delivery evidence; distinguish send attempts from effects.

Pre-register deep finite backlog and ordinary arrival load before execution: at least 12 already-accepted due actions, not refused new dispatches. Exercise multiple budget windows, drain order and bounded progress of old and ordinary work; SATURATED observed; every valid marker eventually settles. Include slow/failed transport and unshared reviewer variation. Define finite test duration and report max latency, no universal FIFO claim from samples.

Measure SQLite/file/CPU contribution within actual holds under declared load; state empirical maxima, environment and sample count. Do not call a measured maximum a hard guarantee or suppress outliers. No host clock change or production stress.
Correct plans/README.md capacity numbers to17/1/7, overload17 with T2/T3 refused; bind revised README separately without rewriting old claim.

A discovered product defect stops affected proof: report reproducer and smallest successor change to Tern BEFORE production edits. Sponsor authorizes a minimal successor if needed; this release does not authorize an unspecified patch or reset. No automatic repair.

No main/install/fleet tasks/live qualification/cutover. Isolated test processes and disposable evidence roots allowed, exact cleanup required. Source/binary hashes rechecked before and after. COMPLETE only if all evidence obligations met; else INCOMPLETE/FAIL with residual.
ruling_b: Empirical host-local latency characterization is accepted as evidence scope; does not establish a hard bound on arbitrary storage stalls. Record host dependency explicitly for live readiness.
ruling_f: SATURATED is not an ack is an already-retained semantic constraint, not a request to make alarms count as acknowledgements. No infinite-load guarantee demanded. Finite backlog eventual drain does not waive live detection/recovery/ack criteria.
review: Fresh corvid30m after COMPLETE claim; independently reproduce and vary load/crash point. Preserve old review; no new blanket source review required for unchanged code. Return Tern for live decision, no automatic live release.
live_cutover: Existing live75/cutover45 grants remain held and unchanged
